subject: general
question: Which of the following natural regions is known for evergreen dense forests and high biodiversity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Equatorial region**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Equatorial region** is characterized by dense forests, commonly known as **tropical rainforests**, which are evergreen in nature.
 
• This region experiences a **hot and humid climate** throughout the year, with average annual temperatures ranging between **25°C to 30°C**.
 
• It receives abundant **rainfall**, usually exceeding **2000 mm annually**, distributed relatively evenly across the year.
 
• The biodiversity in this region is unparalleled, hosting a variety of flora and fauna. Examples include **mahogany trees, orchids, ferns, jaguars, sloths, and toucans**.
 
• Prominent areas belonging to the equatorial region include the **Amazon Basin** in South America, the **Congo Basin** in Africa, and parts of Southeast Asia, such as **Indonesia** and **Malaysia**.
 
• These forests play a vital role in maintaining **global oxygen levels** and are often referred to as the "**lungs of the Earth**."
 
• This region is crucial for regulating the Earth's **carbon cycle** and combating **climate change** due to its ability to absorb large amounts of carbon dioxide.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Equatorial region.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Features of Equatorial Region:**

 
 
• The region is located near the **equator**, between **0° and 10° latitude** north and south.
 
• It has a **constant day length** throughout the year, with approximately **12 hours of daylight** daily.
 
• The soil in this region, known as **lateritic soil**, is nutrient-poor due to heavy rainfall causing leaching, but it supports dense vegetation.
 
• Examples of tropical rainforests include the **Amazon Rainforest**, the **Congo Rainforest**, and the rainforests of **Borneo**.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity in Equatorial Forests:**
 
 
• Equatorial forests are home to **50% of the world’s species**, including rare and endangered species.
 
• The region contains numerous **canopy layers**, with unique ecosystems existing at each layer.
 
• Key plant species include **rubber trees**, **bamboo**, and **epiphytes**.
 
• Animal species include **tigers, parrots, snakes, frogs, and monkeys**.
 
 
 
• **Global Importance:**
 
 
• Equatorial forests act as a major **carbon sink**, absorbing large amounts of **carbon dioxide** and mitigating climate change.
 
• They are crucial for **global weather patterns** due to their role in the **hydrological cycle**.
 
• These forests are vital for **medicinal resources**, as many plant species are used in pharmaceuticals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Natural Regions:**

 
 
• **Tundra Region:** Characterized by extremely cold temperatures, sparse vegetation (like mosses and lichens), and a short growing season. Found in areas like **Russia**, **Canada**, and **Greenland**.
 
• **Steppe Region:** Known for vast grasslands, moderate rainfall, and semi-arid conditions. Found in regions like **Mongolia**, **Kazakhstan**, and parts of **Central Asia**.
 
• **Mediterranean Region:** Characterized by hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters. Found in areas like **Southern Europe**, **California**, and parts of **Australia**.
